nodes.title: No canonical tree-digest algorithm exists, and a naive one produces false drift on CRLF
nodes.problem: There is no shared, canonical, cross-platform tree-digest routine. Measured trap: hashing raw bytes over the same file list on the two sides gives DIFFERENT digests (working tree e143c9c3… vs installed 64cd947c…) purely because 34 text files are CRLF in the git checkout and LF in the installed payload. Any identity primitive must normalise line endings on UTF-8-decodable files and pass binaries through untouched (14 of the payload files are binary: .png, .pyd, .ttf — a naive replace corrupts them and produces false mismatches).
nodes.evidence: Measured on this host: 1805 shared files; 1771 byte-identical; 34 differ only by CRLF (raw digest MISMATCH: e143c9c3… vs 64cd947c…); 1 genuinely differs (the pypanel). Cost measured: full-tree sha256 0.264 s / 98.4 MB / 1972 files; .py-only 0.166 s / 1552 files; both sides 0.236-0.244 s for the 1805-file subset.

nodes.title: Make the installation receipt carry the tree's content identity, not just a check summary
nodes.problem: The per-file identity of the installed tree has no canonical, cheap, quotable carrier. The per-file map exists (payload-manifest.json + installation.json.runtimes[active].files) but a consumer wanting 'is this tree the tree we installed?' must re-hash 1972 files (0.224 s) or reimplement digest conventions. seams.title: The release string has a fourth derivation that ends in a stale hardcoded literal
seams.why_seam: One truth ("what release am I") is derived four ways, and one of them can only ever say "5.8.0" — a value that is not the release and is not derived from any source of truth. If the import fails and the package metadata is absent, serverInfo.version on every MCP initialize reports 5.8.0 while the tree is 5.97.6. The fix is to delete the literal and derive from the one canonical source, which is pure engineering and is already the repo law (VERSION is canonical; scripts/sync_version.py owns the surfaces).

global_invariants: VERSION is the single source of the release label; the fix must consolidate carriers, never add a third. A release string that is not derived from VERSION is a defect even when it is currently correct.

The preflight gate's refusal semantics and ordering must survive: the version is compared first because it needs no hop, then the hop checks; a real mismatch must still refuse the change and still name the fix; a NOT_APPLICABLE must never be reported as a pass, and a missing carrier must never be silently upgraded to a match.

Content identity must be normalised for text (CRLF) and passed through untouched for binaries. 34 files under python/synapse differ between the working tree and the installed payload by line endings alone, so a raw-byte digest across the two sides produces false drift.

Any identity comparison must be computable from BOTH sides of the transport, or it is theatre — the stdio bridge and the Houdini side must each derive the value from something both can see, without a private channel.

Unmeasured is UNKNOWN, never pass, never zero. A check that could not run reports a reason; it never reports green. This is the standing evidence law in harness/attest/SPEC.md and it binds every fix below.

The panel is in-process with Houdini. Any /mcp identity scheme must distinguish 'the panel talking to its own Houdini' from 'an external MCP client', and must not require a client to assert a SYNAPSE release it does not own.
Read-only diagnostics must not gain mutating authority. A runtime tree-drift check must not write to the installed tree, the stamp, or the receipt; a peer check must not change the peer.

The product tree's reported_model discipline (model_access.py:523-528/618, panel/providers/anthropic_provider.py:342, jev/adapter.py:157) is the existing precedent for effective-model capture. The harness must reuse that shape, not invent a parallel one.
Failure must stay honest and attributable: a refused, disabled, or failed check states what failed and where, and the artist/operator is never shown a green that was not earned.
No hardcoded user paths. Every path used by an identity or drift check must derive from the package registration, the install receipt, or SYNAPSE_ROOT — never a literal machine path.

One truth, one carrier: where two records describe the same thing, exactly one of them is authoritative and the other derives from it or is deleted. The receipt and the stamp must never disagree about what the installed tree is.

The bridge, the panel, the doctor, and the server must all report the SAME identity values for the same tree; a fix that makes one surface stricter while another keeps echoing leaves a third disagreement behind.
